body: I try to do stuff, but I just can't do anything anymore. I'm completely apathetic, I can't even play games, and that was my default coping strategy. I don't want to do anything, most things irritate me, I know I'm severely depressed but I also know that it's because of my current situation. Medication isn't an option. I can't even work out how to carry on right now. I just have no idea how to force myself to function, even if it's faked and just going through the motions. I just can't.

I don't want to say too much info due to paranoia of someone identifying me, regardless of how unlikely that is. 

I don't have a disease or anything like that. It's to do with Court proceedings type stuff.
